newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait exchange volume down 6.3 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait exchange volume down 6.3 pct in August.

text.p: Trading volume at the Kuwait Stock Exchange eased a month-on-month 6.3 percent to 2.14 billion shares in August, the exchange said on Sunday.
The value of traded shares fell 15.5 percent to 387.4 million dinars ($1.3 billion) in the same period, the exchange said in a statement.
The share index gained 18.6 points, or 1.1 percent, to 1,626.1. Losses led gains 31-19 and six shares were non-movers.
Average daily volume was 102.256 million shares with an average daily value of 18.450 million dinars.
Property shares were the most active sector by volume, accounting for 49.3 percent. Investment firms came second with 21.9 percent and banks with 12.7 percent.
Properties were also the most active stocks by value with 43.9 percent, followed by banks with 20.7 percent and investment stocks with 17.3 percent.
